node: AI-server MLCCs and upstream barium titanate dielectric powders
summary: Expanded the US-tradable universe for the AI-server MLCC / barium-titanate dielectric-powder node. The cleanest reference lane is Japanese passive-component leaders with OTC ADRs, especially Murata and TDK. The underfollowed lane is much thinner: Sakai Chemical appears to be the most node-pure public powder supplier but trades in the US only as an illiquid OTC foreign ordinary; Vishay is US-listed and underfollowed relative to AI hardware leaders, but its AI-server MLCC exposure is weaker and needs customer/product verification. No buy/sell recommendation is made.
